name: io.github.tufantunc/ssh-mcp
title: SSH — policy-gated remote access
description: Policy-gated, audited SSH for Linux and Windows hosts: roles, approvals, and an audit log.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the configured profile; a per-profile SSH_MCP_<PROFILE>_PASSWORD takes precedence. Credentials are never accepted as CLI arguments.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the private key file to authenticate with — the path, not the key material. A per-profile SSH_MCP_<PROFILE>_KEY takes precedence.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for an encrypted private key.

environmentVariables.name: SSH_MCP_SUDO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password the sudo tool escalates with, when the policy in force allows the privileged class.
